decision: Keep #3153 default merge-ready, #3214 ceremony dial, #3145 consumer check trio, and #3225 advisory-verdict blocking. Do not relax those gates or consumer check composition to recover the two 0.92-0.99 hard-task fails. The two tasks are not worth weakening gate integrity.

governingRule.description: When a quality gate fails, fix the product/process/test under test. Do not clear red by editing the gate, verifier, required check, coverage floor, or policy flag solely to go green.

alternativesConsidered.option: Remove drive-to:merge-ready as the default envelope (#3153 revert)
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Silent PR-open handback is the #1880 / #3032 failure class. Default merge-ready is correct for real story work.

alternativesConsidered.option: Drop the #3145 trio from consumer task check
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: That is editing the gate that surfaced lifecycle/toolchain work. Warn-default already exists. Removal would hide placement and provenance defects.

alternativesConsidered.option: Stop treating advisory reviewer prose as a merge-ready block (#3225 revert)
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: #3225 is not the inserter on this profile. Reverting it would re-open merge-against-advice on org repos.

alternativesConsidered.option: Classify every vanilla deposit as non-project so mid x L stays minimal
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Would under-ceremony real consumer projects. Shape must stay explicit (CLI/env or a later task-kind signal), not a silent default flip.

whyWinner: The named cause is over-application of intentional story/merge-ready process to one-shot hard tasks. The gates themselves are correct for their intended profile. Recovery belongs in a scoped follow-up (bank mid-run product pass; optional one-shot envelope) plus #3322/#3323 oracle work, not in a check or review-gate rollback.
revisitTrigger: If a follow-up ships a one-shot / bank-before-reverify envelope and the two tasks recover without touching check or #3225, this decision stays. Re-open only if new evidence shows #3145 or #3225 themselves flip a mid-run product pass to fail without a process tail.
